output.brief: The rise from 0.31% to 0.41% looks like ordinary week-to-week variation, not a confirmed fault. Over the prior 26 weeks the weekly rate averaged 0.354% and the normal upper edge was 0.482%. This week's 0.411% sits inside that band. Three earlier weeks (0.44%, 0.51% and 0.45%) were higher. Each was investigated and nothing was found. The error budget burn is 0.82x, well under the 2x paging threshold. The dashboard numbers match a recount from raw logs, so this is not a counting artefact. Bookings were flat (41.0% vs 41.2%) and there were no complaints. The rollout comparison (31 of 5,960 vs 22 of 7,330) rests on very small counts and does not separate the new version from chance. I'm moderately confident. I did not test the replica move or the partner-sync run, so those stay open. Recommendation: do not roll back and do not move the replica. Note the week at ops review and apply the standard check to next week. Do not mute the alerts, because that would remove your protection for no benefit. If next week exceeds the band, investigate then.
